title: 3-Box Dual-Isotope Methane Source Attribution

NHext.monitoring: NOAA flask network, AGAGE, Greenland stations

Trop.dominant_sources: tropical wetlands, rice, livestock, tropical BB
Trop.monitoring: Sparse! Mauna Loa, Cape Grim edge, Ascension Island

equations:
Mass balance for each box i ∈ {NHext, Trop, SHext}:

        dM_i/dt = S_i - M_i/τ_i + Σ_j (M_j - M_i)/τ_{ij}

        where:
          M_i = CH₄ mass in box i
          S_i = total source in box i (= BB_i + FF_i + Mic_i)
          τ_i = chemical lifetime in box i
          τ_{ij} = exchange time between boxes i and j

        Isotope mass balance (for ¹³CH₄):
          d(R_i·M_i)/dt = R_src_i·S_i - α_i·R_i·M_i/τ_i + Σ_j (R_j·M_j - R_i·M_i)/τ_{ij}

        Same for CH₃D (δD).

        System: 9 unknowns (3 sources × 3 boxes)
                9 equations (3 mass + 3 δ¹³C + 3 δD)
        
        → Exactly determined! (vs. 2-box: 6 unknowns, 6 equations)
        → Each box needs: CH₄ concentration, δ¹³C, δD (3 observables)

CH4_zonal.source: NOAA GML flask + in-situ, zonal means available

d13C_zonal.issue: Tropical δ¹³C is interpolated from NH/SH stations, not independent

dD_zonal.source: Only a few sites globally (ALT, MLO, CGO, SPO)
dD_zonal.issue: Cannot independently constrain 3 zonal δD values
dD_zonal.uncertainty: ±3‰ per station, but too few stations for tropical mean

source_signatures_zonal.issue: Tropical source sigs less well-characterized than NH

feasibility_assessment.verdict: NOT YET FEASIBLE for full implementation
feasibility_assessment.timeline: Feasible within 5-10 years if IRMS/TILDAS network expands
feasibility_assessment.workaround: Could use satellite-derived CH₄ + δ¹³C (GOSAT) with modeled δD priors
feasibility_assessment.advantage_over_2box: Separates tropical wetland signal from NH industrial + SH background. Current 2-box lumps tropical into NH+SH, losing the dominant signal.

key_question: Would the 3-box resolve the tropical wetland surge that drives post-2019 acceleration? The 2-box lumps tropical sources into NH and SH equally, but most tropical wetland emissions are near-equatorial. A 3-box could independently estimate the tropical microbial trend.
